name: Manifest Foundation (20A/31S/26R/7P/71perm)
description: Manifest (20 activities, 31 services, 26 receivers, 7 providers, 71 permissions); minSdk 23/targetSdk 36; requiredSplitTypes=base__abi proves native libs ship as separate split.
behavior_summary: Declares the full component surface; push/call/sync services and the permission reference list.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference permission model and service topology for Family OS.

name: DispatchQueue Managed-Thread Model
description: Thread+Looper+Handler per queue; CountDownLatch readiness gate; postRunnable/postToFrontRunnable/sendMessage/cancelRunnable/cleanupQueue/recycle; getLastTaskTime deadlock watchdog; thread-priority constructor; global index counter.
behavior_summary: Every heavy workload gets a named queue with readiness contract and deadlock monitoring.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the 159-line class verbatim as the threading primitive of Family OS.

name: NotificationCenter Event Bus (348 events)
description: 348 measured event IDs; per-account + global instances; SparseArray observers; main-thread-only posting (DEBUG enforced); broadcast-deferred add/remove; 5017ms animation deferral; debounce dedup; heavy-ops gating; weak observer groups with leak logging.
behavior_summary: Central pub/sub replacing callback webs between modules.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt as the official inter-module bus; rename events for Family OS domains.

name: Multi-Account Singleton Mesh (AccountInstance[4])
description: Instance[4] cap with double-checked locking; 18 getX() per-account singleton gates; BaseController.currentAccount; UserConfig per-account session state.
behavior_summary: Isolates per-user state (messages/settings/storage) inside one process.

reusability_assessment.notes: One unit per family member = one account; the indexed-singleton mesh is the isolation mechanism.

name: Native Update Ingress Path (JNI->stageQueue->processUpdates)
description: onUnparsedMessageReceived: NativeByteBuffer.wrap -> TLRPC.Updates.TLdeserialize -> KeepAliveJob.finishJob -> stageQueue -> MessagesController.processUpdates; Updates-typed responses routed to processUpdates; getDifference() on TL_updatesTooLong/seq gaps/session creation; freeResources() discipline.
behavior_summary: The complete network-to-UI update pipeline with gap recovery.

reusability_assessment.notes: The mandatory blueprint for Family OS message sync: single ingress, one stage queue, diff on gaps.

name: ConnectionsManager JNI Bridge (27+ native_*)
description: 27+ static native declarations (init/sendRequest/datacenter/proxy/network/DNS/lang); Java is a thin coordinator; C++ core absent (split).
behavior_summary: Thin JNI bridge pattern: critical networking in native, orchestration in Java.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt the bridge discipline: performance-critical code native, logic in Kotlin/Java.

name: Connection Multiplexing (5 types, 8 download conns)
description: Types Generic=1/Download=2/Download2=65538/Upload=4/Push=8; states Connecting=1/WaitingForNetwork=2/Connected=3/ConnectingToProxy=4/Updating=5; DownloadConnectionsCount=8; 12 request flags (NeedQuickAck, DownloadByteBudget...).
behavior_summary: Per-purpose connection multiplexing with declared request capabilities.

reusability_assessment.notes: Design the Family OS protocol client with typed connections and capability flags.

name: DNS-over-HTTPS Failover + DC Management
description: GoogleDnsLoadTask then MozillaDnsLoadTask fallback with 10s throttle; native_applyDnsConfig; test backend tapv3.stel.com; didUpdateConnectionState UI propagation.
behavior_summary: DNS hijack resistance and datacenter mobility.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy for Yemen/region reliability where DNS is unreliable.

name: Triple-Layer Push (native+FCM+Huawei, AES-IGE payloads)
description: Dedicated native push connection; FCM with AES-IGE-encrypted 'p' payload (FCM sees no content); Huawei type 13; KeepAliveJob keeps process alive during push handling then finishes.
behavior_summary: Redundant push with always-encrypted payloads and battery-efficient keep-alive.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adapt to Family OS servers; keep the encrypted-payload principle.

name: E2E Secret-Chat Crypto Boundary (AES-IGE, device-only keys)
description: EncryptedChat{auth_key device-only, key_hash fingerprint, layer}; decryptWithMtProtoVersion; AES-IGE via JNI; acceptSecretChat (DH); enc_chats local-only.
behavior_summary: Two-tier trust model: cloud-synced normal chats, device-only secret chats.

reusability_assessment.notes: Family 'secret mode': device key + AES-IGE + local-only storage; copy trust boundaries, not the protocol verbatim.

name: Media Pipeline (FileLoader: 32K/128Kx4, prio queues)
description: 5 small + 5 large priority queues (per DC); upload cap 1+1; chunks 32KB/128KB, 10MB big threshold, 4 parallel requests; priorities LOW=0/NORMAL=0x10000/MAX=0x100000; loadFile() overloads per type.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the numbers (32K/128K x4, 10MB) - battle-tested on billions of files.

name: Autodownload Policy Engine (per-network bitmasks)
description: Per-network bitmasks (mobile/roaming/wifi x media type); canDownloadMedia(Type) gates; server-synced config; DownloadRequestPacer; download_queue persistence.
behavior_summary: Data policy balancing UX and bandwidth per network.

reusability_assessment.notes: Family data policy ready-made, critical for Yemeni networks.

name: Custom Native SQLite Wrapper (no ORM)
description: 4 classes, 454 lines; opendb/beginTransaction/commitTransaction native; prepared statements; explainQuery diagnostics. Zero ORM.
behavior_summary: Raw-SQL performance discipline via prepared statements.

reusability_assessment.notes: Local message DB with the same discipline: prepared statements, no ORM overhead.

name: cache4.db Schema + Hole Tracking (WAL, ~80 tables)
description: Per-account WAL database; ~80 tables (messages/dialogs/chats/users/enc_chats/...); requested_holes+params = sync-gap tracking storage.
behavior_summary: Durable local state with explicit gap accounting for resync.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the hole-tracking pattern for Family OS offline-first sync.

name: TLRPC Schema Corpus (80k lines, 2043 ctors)
description: 80,043 lines / 2,043 TL classes with TLdeserialize/serializeToStream; TLClassStore constructor dispatch; NativeByteBuffer little-endian serialization.
behavior_summary: Complete binary protocol schema as design reference.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for graduated envelopes (updateShort*); do NOT copy the 80k lines.

name: 10M+ Scale Patterns Checklist (13 patterns)
description: Central serialization, connection multiplexing, diff resync, graduated envelopes, request flags, DNS failover, encrypted push, proven chunking, notification dedup, freeResources(), deadlock watchdog, WAL+prepared, native critical core.

reusability_assessment.notes: Mandatory checklist for the Family OS communication module.

name: VoIP Native Bridge (36 native methods)
description: NativeInstance: 36 native methods over WebRTC-derived lib (video capturers, incoming video outputs); Instance.java wrapper; OS telecom integration.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for family calls later; do not build calls from scratch.

name: Self-Monitoring (ANRDetector + getLastTaskTime)
description: ANRDetector class; per-queue last-task timestamps; heavy-ops gating during animations.
behavior_summary: Built-in deadlock/stall detection as a quality gate.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt as the 'zero-hang' quality standard for Family OS.
